agriculture.say: The engineering underneath is the same.
agriculture.say_body:
The companies that built all of it sell through custom operators, ag retail and a dealer network. No defence sourcing system reads any of those channels, so none of them holds a record of the company.

That same company can tell you whether it has ever missed a window, and defence procurement has no established route for asking.

technology.say: There is a company that has already passed this review.
technology.say_body:
That review was run for another department, which is why the company has never appeared in front of you.

A quality accreditation travels between buyers, and a security authorization does not.

energy.say: There is a second source for that package.
energy.say_body:
It has never been on your approved vendor list, because your approved vendor list is a record of who supplied the last project.

Vendor prequalification ranks the companies already on the list. A company that has never supplied a capital project never reaches the ranking.

military.say: A fleet under its target is a published number, and a number carries no date for closing the gap.
military.say_body:
The following year's results carry the same fleet again.

When a part on a fleet already in service becomes unsupportable, there are two ways back to full serviceability.

manufacturing.say: Better is weighed against the change.
manufacturing.say_body:
An alternative has to beat the incumbent by more than a tool move, a bank of finished parts built to cover the weeks nothing is made, and a full approval run again from the start.

Part approval is a package of evidence for one part, made on one set of tooling, in one plant, by one process, closed by a warrant your customer signs.

construction.say: There is a trade that can hold that package.
construction.say_body:
It has never bid your work, because a surety has no history to underwrite and a prequalification service has no record to score.

A surety underwrites character, capacity and capital, and reads all three from a track record built with that surety.
